fields.Name: T148 - Form Builder Center Pane
fields.Description: Opens a form in Component Studio's Form Studio once, then walks its center-pane code paths (Preview/Code/Layout mode switch, canvas add-section-and-element mutation), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T368-T369.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to Component Studio -> Form Studio and click an existing form in the left 'Forms' rail to load it into the center pane (prefer a form that is NOT in 'Custom code'/Layout-disabled mode). Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) center-pane-mode-switch - locate the segmented view-mode control (Preview / Code / Layout) and click through the modes, confirming the center pane content changes ('Code' shows a code editor, 'Layout' shows the drag-and-drop canvas of sections/fields, 'Preview' shows the live form render or preview record strip); note the 'Layout' tab may be intentionally disabled with a 'Custom code' chip for hand-authored forms - that is a valid state, not an error; (2) canvas-add-section-element - switch to the 'Layout' view to reveal the canvas, confirm it renders sections, click 'Add Section' and confirm a new section appears, then in a section header click an add-element button (Add static text / Add computed field / Add spacer) and confirm a new element is added to that section (the form becoming dirty / Save enabling is success - do NOT save). Keep going until both sections have been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: center-pane-mode-switch
checkpoints.instruction: switch the Preview/Code/Layout mode and see the center pane change
visualCriteria: With a form selected, using the Preview/Code/Layout segmented control changes the center pane content accordingly, with at least two of the three modes rendering distinct content (e.g. Code shows an editor, Layout shows a canvas or is intentionally disabled with a 'Custom code' explanation)

checkpoints.name: canvas-add-section-element
checkpoints.instruction: add a section and an element on the Layout canvas
visualCriteria: The Layout view shows the form-builder canvas with sections and an 'Add Section' control; clicking 'Add Section' adds a section AND clicking a section's add-element button (static text/computed/spacer) adds an element to that section
